def evolved_p96(x, N, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                 cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    # x[i,j] = popcount(i XOR j) = sum_k |bit_k(i) - bit_k(j)|.
    # Position-based, no collective. No bitwise ops (unsupported).
    idx = torch.arange(N, dtype=torch.long, device=x.device)
    ii = idx.view(N, 1)
    jj = idx.view(1, N)
    pc = None
    for k in (1, 2, 4, 8):
        ai = (ii // k) % 2
        aj = (jj // k) % 2
        d = ai - aj
        term = d * d
        pc = term if pc is None else pc + term
    return pc.to(x.dtype)
